Global options such as `--base-url`, `--tenant` and `--json` go before the command — see [CLI reference](./index.mdx#global-options). Exit codes are listed in [Exit codes](./exit-codes.md).

## apiome config {#config}

Show or change saved defaults in the user config file.

```text
apiome config [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`set`](#config-set), [`show`](#config-show), [`unset`](#config-unset).

## apiome config set {#config-set}

Persist a default to the user config file.

```text
apiome config set [OPTIONS] KEY VALUE
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `KEY` | text | yes | Setting name: base-url, tenant, api-key, or session-token. |
| `VALUE` | text | yes | Value to persist in the user config file. |

## apiome config show {#config-show}

Print values stored in the user config file (api-key is masked).

```text
apiome config show [OPTIONS]
```

## apiome config unset {#config-unset}

Remove a default from the user config file.

```text
apiome config unset [OPTIONS] KEY
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `KEY` | text | yes | Setting name: base-url, tenant, api-key, or session-token. |
